Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, then to assays on assay_id, then to target_dictionary on tid. Join compound_records on activities.record_id for compound_key and docs for pubmed_id_or_doi. Join compound_structures on molregno for canonical_smiles. Filter by target_chembl_id CHEMBL1741186 and standard_type IC50. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
